slope_p50_deg.rationale: Separates modest median-slope differences without implying measurement uncertainty.

slope_p90_deg.rationale: Allows wider variation in the steep-terrain tail.

local_relief_p50_m.rationale: A 10% difference relative to the 1 km relief neighborhood.

local_relief_p90_m.rationale: Allows greater variation in high-relief cells.

roughness_mean.rationale: Elevation standard deviation in a 300 m neighborhood; initial transparent engineering tolerance.

roughness_p90.rationale: Wider tolerance for the roughness tail.
